title: Cycle 3 • Recovery rollout readiness
evidence_classification: Static design proposal plus preserved prior proof; no new product execution

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: persists two entity_types that share a source_id within one intent
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Cross-family same s: insert count 2 and stored types exactly client/workout.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C; the enabling index drop and this discriminator ship together.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: reports deduped = 0 when every entity in the batch is distinct
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Three distinct entity types sharing s: received − count = 0.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C; negative control on R still deduplicates.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: treats a full 5-tuple replay as a no-op
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Full five-tuple replay: count 0; stored count 1.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: Useful H baseline; rerun E/T/R/N and C exact-identity state.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: keeps captured_at OUT of the key — a fresh timestamp is a replay, not a new row
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Different captured_at is still replay: count 0, total 1.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline onward; retain timestamp-out-of-key assertion.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: collapses in-batch duplicates of the same 5-tuple
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Same-tuple duplicate within one batch collapses: count 1.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline onward and C.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: starts a new observation series for a different intent_id
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Different intent: next count 1, total 2.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline onward and C; keep intent scope.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: scopes the key per coach — another coach is never deduped against this one
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Different coach: next count 1.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline onward and C; keep coach scope.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: reverses cleanly when no row depends on the widened key
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Collision-free full reverse: old staging index present, wide absent, staging rows byte-equivalent before/down/up.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C.down→R.down→E.down→E/R/C returns full S0/C boundary; every stage also proves its own down/up. C.down alone intentionally retains wide index.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: REFUSES to reverse — rather than delete data — when rows only the widened key permits exist
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Cross-family collision blocks reverse with duplicate error; two rows and wide key remain.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C.down; failure atomic and data-preserving.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: keeps ENABLE + FORCE row level security on the table
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Staging relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity are true.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline, E, R and C; no relaxation.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: keeps exact restrictive client denial and permissive service policy semantics
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Exactly 3 staging policies: exact names/roles, ALL commands, permissive service true/true, restrictive anon/auth false/false.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline and each schema stage; enumerate catalog values, not policy existence alone.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: persists the same source ID on two platforms through the real service and replays unchanged
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Real service: two platforms received=2/deduped=0; changed timestamp/payload replay deduped=2 and stored rows unchanged.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C with real service/client, not only mocked insertion.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: ignores a same-named table in a different schema in catalog lookups
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Decoy-schema index is excluded from application index catalog.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H catalog helper and E/R/C ownership tests.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: refuses repeated raw migration execution atomically (Prisma history owns reruns)
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Raw migration rerun throws; index names unchanged and one row retained.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: Each E/R/C raw rerun fails atomically; full chain has explicit entry-state tests, not unchecked IF NOT EXISTS.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: targets the public table/index OIDs in BOTH directions despite a shadow schema
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Shadow search_path cannot redirect up/down; cross-family insert count 2; shadow narrow and wide indexes survive.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: E/R/C use schema-qualified objects; C cross-family proof and full reverse chain keep decoys untouched.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: reconstructs and replays identical IDs across platforms without losing ledger counts
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Three staged platforms (truecoach/conformance_alpha/unknown), same workout s: reconstructed=2, skipped=1, failed=0; repeat leaves 3 ledger rows and 2 targets.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C real reconstruction + second replay; unknown is actual staged value, not invented backfill provenance.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: backfills exact ledger provenance and refuses orphaned history without fabricating a platform
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Exact legacy match backfills truecoach, retaining skipped status. Orphan re-up throws NULL error, leaves narrow key and no p column at original pre-expand boundary.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: B exact provenance + R refusal; deliberately changed stage boundary: R failure retains E nullable column. Full drained safe unwind to S0 must preserve the original column-absence assertion. Do not claim literal old atomic shape at R.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: refuses a platform-losing rollback atomically
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Platform collision blocks reverse; staging wide index and both rows remain.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C.down; no lossy narrowing.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: proves real non-superuser CRUD denial even with hostile permissive policy
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Non-superuser/non-bypass anon/auth: read/update/delete=0, insert 42501; hostile permissive policy cannot undo restrictive read/update/delete denial. Inherited service-role probe: authorized CRUD counts, transaction rollback leaves original row.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: H baseline plus E/R/C. Preserve role flags, grants, transaction rollback and all CRUD checks. Original hostile INSERT probe is not concurrent with hostile policy; add that stronger check separately.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: rolls back the first narrowing index when the ledger alone requires platform separation
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Ledger-only platform collision blocks reverse, leaves 2 ledger rows, wide keys present and first narrow-index creation rolled back.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: C.down atomically recreates BOTH narrow indexes; verify no half-narrow state.

original_21_case_inventory.original_name: refuses an unrelated public index instead of dropping it
original_21_case_inventory.obligations: Unrelated public object owning expected narrow-index name: migration refuses owner mismatch, decoy table unchanged.
original_21_case_inventory.proposed_mapping: E/R prerequisite guards; C entry/down guards matched to their actual stage; retain exact wrong-owner discriminator.

new_proof_requirements.proof: Separately generated O/T/N clients in isolated processes; capture actual INSERT, native-vs-emulated upsert, selector, result materialization and SQLSTATE. Negative controls O/R, N/E, O/C.
Simultaneous creates/replays for success, skipped and failed branches; NULL claim, O update retains p, no mismatch overwrite and target/ledger atomic rollback.
O writes during E lock; lock-timeout atomicity. O inserts after B chunk create late NULL; final drain/sweep required. T claim vs B update and staging mutation serialize correctly.
Orphan, invalid p, wrong family, wrong coach/intent, ambiguous/incorrect prerequisite, non-NULL mismatch, erased staging and SKIP LOCKED retries. No fabrication; no stalled-success report.
NULL/noncanonical rows cause R atomic refusal; retained old indexes; T still operates. Measure lock/index-build/validation budgets at representative size. Fence obsolete restart paths.
Both real selectors address same ledger; all status paths and unique-conflict retries. New identities remain blocked by narrow keys; verify dedup counts accurately describe that transitional state.
N+N same full tuple ⇒ one ledger and one target, correct replay; different platform/family ⇒ distinct outcomes. Success vs failure/skip has explicit non-downgrade semantics or blocks release.
ON CONFLICT count accuracy with concurrent replay and new identities. C/down against in-flight writes, staging collision and ledger-only second-index failure; all rows retained, no partial schema.

Q0/Q1 decode both directions; limit=1 tied s across p; legacy ambiguity/missing boundary gives documented restart, cross-scope rejection, erased/missing target behavior, bounds. No O reader or T writer active at C.

Stage-specific exact policy catalogs; non-superuser non-bypass CRUD with hostile permissive policies on staging and ledger; affected target owner checks; wrong schema/owner/definition/invalid-index negatives.

Run each stage’s complete history and own down/up/rerun; manifest all preserved IDs with zero pending/skipped. Target-selection guards and actual CI job invocation fail closed. PostgreSQL 15 CI rehearsal required.
new_proof_requirements.required_by: Every stage; full terminal 21 at C

new_proof_requirements.proof: Late ingest between reconstruction count, offset pages and final tally: determine supported sealing/quiescence contract and test it. Existing one-time settled gate is not a stable snapshot guarantee.
